sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- IRGC spokesman Mohebbi, Nov 7] Iran's air defence units downed at least 260 hostile aircraft during the war, including F-35, F-16, F-8 and F-5 fighter jets alongside various drones and micro-drones. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Mohebbi] Over the past week or two, 7 MQM-170 reconnaissance drones were brought down intact, 'a demonstration of our technological superiority'. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Mohebbi] The IRGC Aerospace Force has achieved 'complete defence independence' through domestic research, with no reliance on foreign advisers; in another conflict Iran would unveil 'groundbreaking aerospace achievements' and any US/Israeli miscalculation would bring blows 'felt for years'. [CONTEXT] The claim follows the Nov 6-7 Qeshm exchange: Trump confirmed limited US strikes on Qeshm air defence (0700-01); Iran's army said it destroyed a US MQ-9 drone over Qeshm -- the drone type is disputed (MQ-1 vs MQ-9, unresolved).
sections.what_verified: ONE tiered family reports the statement: Al Jazeera (T2) liveblog, citing Tasnim. Mehr News Agency (no declared tier) carries the full statement. No tiered family independently confirms any element of the 260 figure. The claim's content is therefore UNVERIFIED; only the fact that Mohebbi said it is established.
sections.what_disputed: Prior identical F-35 downing claims were debunked: BBC Verify found circulated wreckage photos inconsistent with F-35 dimensions/markings; NewsGuard traced the alleged captured-pilot photo to a 2021 image of a Chilean Navy lieutenant; the IDF confirmed all jets returned safely with zero captured personnel (June 2025 claims). The US military has dismissed earlier F-35 claims as false. A CNN-confirmed case exists of ONE F-35 damaged (emergency landing, pilot safe) -- not shot down. No wreckage, pilot or debris evidence has been published for any of the 260 claimed kills. The 1100-08 record already holds Carlson's nuclear claim as unverified/contradicted; this is the same claim family from the other side.
sections.why_matters: Claim-busting frame: the IRGC now claims 260 aircraft downed, including F-35s -- but the last time Tehran claimed F-35 kills, BBC Verify proved the wreckage photo fake and the 'captured pilot' was a Chilean Navy officer from 2021. The number is the story; the missing evidence is the verdict. Present ONLY as an IRGC claim, with the debunk in the same video.

totw_analysis: Our read: Claim-busting frame: the IRGC now claims 260 aircraft downed, including F-35s -- but the last time Tehran claimed F-35 kills, BBC Verify proved the wreckage photo fake and the 'captured pilot' was a Chilean Navy officer from 2021. The number is the story; the missing evidence is the verdict. Present ONLY as an IRGC claim, with the debunk in the same video. The fault line our audience is arguing over: 260 jets down -- or 260 claims with zero wreckage? Tehran says its air defence is now 'completely independent' and unbeatable; every earlier F-35 claim collapsed on photo forensics. Who do you believe -- the spokesman, or the wreckage that never appears?
